title: Cruisin' Cajun Haloumi Rolls
subtitle: with Spinach Salad and Spring Onion
description: Stop the flavour bus! Here's a fab recipe from our culinary dream team. Like all our dishes, it's got five easy cooking steps plus tips and hacks to make it your own. We think it’s a total winner – but you tell us! Leave a rating and comment through your account to let us know your thoughts.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced. Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the eggs. Peel the carrot into ribbons with a vegetable peeler. Finely chop the spring onion. Slice the haloumi. Combine 1 tsp Cajun seasoning (see Make it milder) and 2 tsp olive oil in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the haloumi and toss to coat.
Boil eggs: Cook 2 eggs in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins for soft-boiled, or 8 mins for hard-boiled. Drain, then cool in cold water.

Cook haloumi: Heat a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan. While the haloumi is cooking, halve the rolls. Put the rolls, cut-side up, on an oven tray and bake for 6 mins or until toasted.

Make salad: Meanwhile, combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the carrot, spring onion and spinach and toss to combine. Combine 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tsp Cajun seasoning in a separate bowl.

Serve up: Peel and slice the eggs, then season with salt and pepper. Spread the rolls with the Cajun mayo, then fill with the salad, haloumi and egg. Divide the haloumi rolls among plates and serve with any remaining salad. Enjoy!

Make it milder: Our Cajun seasoning has a bit of heat. If you prefer less spice, reduce the seasoning in the marinade and mayonnaise (Step 4) to taste. Or leave a portion of haloumi and mayonnaise plain.
